mapper.sql: id, order_id as orderId, pay_method as payMethod, amount, status, pay_time as payTime, refund_amount as refundAmount, refund_time as refundTime, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (order_id, pay_method, amount, status, pay_time, refund_amount, refund_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{payMethod}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payTime}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET pay_method = #{payMethod}, status = #{status}, pay_time = #{payTime}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_time = #{refundTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM payment WHERE pay_method = #{payMethod} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE status = #{status}
